messages.text: At 13¢ the 40T runs about $61 a month, with the unit at $799. Most people buy it for the shot at a full block plus steady sats to their own wallet. Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

Good one to start on. The 40T is our best value per TH at $799, runs 650 W, and Harlo OS lets you point it at a pool for steady sats or leave it solo for the block shot — you learn the whole stack on one box. Where would it sit, desk or garage?

Straight with you: 650 W on a desk means real fan noise and a warm room — fine in a garage, noticeable next to you. If quiet matters more than hashrate, the Hammer BC04 (6 TH/s, $239, in stock) is the desk-friendly one. Is noise a dealbreaker, or can you live with a loud fan?

context.pop: At 10¢ the Magic Miner 40T runs about $47 a month, at 16¢ about $75 — what do you pay for power?
